title: Mastering BFS Visited States & Queue Synchronization
summary: Step-by-step visual animation demonstrating why marking vertices as visited immediately upon enqueueing prevents duplicate additions and quadratic time degradation.
key_takeaways: Always mark visited[node] = True BEFORE pushing to queue.
Track parent pointers when reconstructing shortest paths in unweighted graphs.
Use deque.popleft() in Python for O(1) removals vs O(N) list.pop(0).

title: Interactive Graph Traversal Simulator & Edge Cases
summary: Interactive visualizer illustrating layer-by-layer frontier expansion and multi-source BFS.
key_takeaways: Layer-by-layer expansion guarantees minimal edge distance.
Disconnected components require an outer loop over all vertices 0..V-1.

title: Binary Search Invariants & Boundary Proofs
summary: Definitive guide on while(low <= high) vs while(low < high) and preventing mid-point arithmetic overflow.
key_takeaways: Maintain invariant: target lies within search interval [low, high].
Determine which half is strictly sorted before discarding search space.

title: Dynamic Programming Patterns: Unbounded vs 0/1 Knapsack
summary: State transition breakdown for combinatorial sum and optimal substructure problems.
key_takeaways: Define DP[i] as minimum coins needed to make sum i.
Base case: DP[0] = 0, all other DP[i] = infinity.

title: Operating Systems: Process Synchronization & Deadlock Recovery
summary: Clear conceptual diagrams of resource allocation graphs, circular wait prevention, and Peterson's algorithm.
key_takeaways: Mutual Exclusion, Hold and Wait, No Preemption, Circular Wait are necessary and sufficient.
Banker's Algorithm ensures safe state before resource grant.

title: SQL Mastery: DENSE_RANK, RANK, and ROW_NUMBER Demystified
summary: Hands-on guide with examples of top-N queries, cumulative sums, and partitioning.
key_takeaways: ROW_NUMBER assigns distinct integer to each row regardless of duplicates.
RANK skips subsequent rankings on ties.
DENSE_RANK assigns identical rank to ties without skipping subsequent integers.
